<div class="card-body">
'''Blaster Scope''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブラスター・スコープ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍制式ブラスターかブラスター・ライフルに配備する。戦闘の際、その武器で隣接サイトにいるキャラクターやビークルを対象にすることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-199o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ブラスターに電子照準スコープを取り付けると、その威力は飛躍的に上がる。敵が遠距離にいる場合は効果的だ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blaster Scope.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on an Imperial-issue blaster or blaster rifle. During battle, that weapon may target a character or vehicle at an adjacent site.

'''Lore:''' Mounting an electronic targeting scope on a blaster greatly increases its effectiveness, especially at long range.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blaster Scope]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
